premises.text: Idle privately owned bikes are a huge underused pool while shop rentals and public bike share are expensive or poorly suited for leisure rides
premises.evidence_span: there's this huge pool of bicycles that are not being capitalized on

premises.text: SpinLister is a peer-to-peer web marketplace matching excess bike supply with renter demand via reviewed listings, search, filters, and owner messaging
premises.evidence_span: taking this excess supply of bicycles and meeting it with the demand

premises.text: Average daily prices are about half of shop rentals with a wide range set by owners

value.text: Travelers and locals rent diverse bikes conveniently and affordably while owners monetize idle bikes
